offices.about:

Our Listings

REMAX Executive Realty's Holliston office serves buyers and sellers throughout southern MetroWest and neighboring communities, including Hopkinton, Ashland, Sherborn, Medway, Millis, Milford, Medfield and the surrounding area. Routes 16 and 126 provide local connections, with nearby access to I-495 and the Massachusetts Turnpike (Route 90) linking the region to employment and commercial centers throughout MetroWest, Greater Boston and Central Massachusetts. This location gives buyers room to consider several nearby markets while helping sellers reach buyers whose searches may extend across southern MetroWest and toward the I-495 corridor.

Housing across the region includes historic properties, established single-family neighborhoods, condominiums and townhomes, newer construction and homes with larger lots. Inventory, pricing, property characteristics and buyer demand can differ substantially even among neighboring communities, making a broader view of the market valuable on either side of the process. REMAX Executive Realty agents combine local knowledge with an understanding of those market differences, helping buyers take advantage of opportunities and sellers best position their homes to compete in the broader regional market.

Offices in Clinton, Framingham, Franklin, Grafton, Holliston, Hopkinton, Hyannis, Marlborough, Westborough

Since its establishment in 1980, RE/MAX Preferred has become a leading real estate firm in South Central Wisconsin, celebrated for its excellence, reliability, and deep market expertise. With a wide network of offices in Baraboo, Fort Atkinson, Johnson Creek, La Valle, Madison, Mineral Point, Monona, Oregon, Poynette, Reedsburg, Sauk City, Sun Prairie, Waunakee, and Wisconsin Dells, we are committed to providing unmatched service throughout the region.

Our journey of growth reflects our passion and dedication. In 2023, RE/MAX Baraboo merged with RE/MAX Preferred, a strategic decision to unify resources, extend our service areas, and enhance the support available to our agents and clients. This merger has reinforced RE/MAX Preferred’s position as a leader in South Central Wisconsin's real estate market.

Currently, RE/MAX Preferred supports over 100 independent agents across our offices. Our leadership team—Dan Bertelson, Tim Krueger, Nanci Jenks, and Raegen Trimmer—remains dedicated to fostering the growth and success of our agents. We are committed to equipping them with the latest tools, techniques, and resources to ensure exceptional client service.

Our unwavering dedication to both our agents and clients has cemented RE/MAX Preferred’s reputation as a reliable, knowledgeable, and results-oriented brokerage. As we continue to grow and evolve, our focus remains on delivering exceptional service and achieving remarkable outcomes for the communities we proudly serve.
